## Introduction

`{nullis}` is an extension of `{statim}` dedicated for nonparametric statistics

## Current 

Here are the collection of Hypothesis tests under nonparametric statistics implemented in `{nullis}`:

1.  Mood's median test (`MEDIAN_TEST()`)
2.  Friedman's Rank Sum Test (`FRIEDMAN_TEST()`)
3.  Kruskal-Wallis H test (`KW_TEST()`)
4.  Jonckheere-Terpstra Test (`JT_TEST()`)
